close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-filenode-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; clippy clean
description:
Update register_filenode_handlers to forward CallerCtx using ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1).

All FileNode/* handler closures receive ctx: C. Important for filenode servers enforcing access control on blob_exists checks and sibling-name lookups.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_filenode_handlers closures receive CallerCtx
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1.
title: jmap-filenode-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_filenode_handlers
